notes.title: Playtest 0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone

This new build 0.3 includes the following fixes : 
- Fixed buff stacking when not supposed to
- Fixed an issue where allied buff where not displayed in the rune pick menu
- Preparing ground for save/load and autosave
- Updated visual mopve feedback

notes.title: Playtest 0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The 0.2 version of the playtest is here! It includes some small fixes :
- Fixed units wigglign around when moving a group of units and clicking inside the group to move
- Fixed units trying to reach endlessly unreachable locations (inside the boundaries of a building for example)
- Fixed an issue where units focusing a target would not avoid obstacle on the way

notes.title: Very small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone, today I rolled on a very small update for three things : 

- Added link to store page
- Added a small alpha panel on the main menu screen

And most of all to test the update process since I plan on updating the game with your feedbacks as many times and as fast as possible!

Simon Carter.
